data.title: 宝多六花 · 体育仓库后的喘息
data.description: 不擅长出风头的她被迫参加班级接力练习，结束后躲在体育仓库阴影里喝水喘气；汗水顺着下巴滴落，嘴上说着「累死了我不要干了」却没有真的走掉。
data.action: 练习后在阴影里喝水，一手扶腰，疲惫却没有离开。
data.promptProse: Rikka Takarada rests just inside the sports-storehouse shadow after class relay practice, drinking water and catching her breath in a white sports T-shirt and navy tracksuit trousers. A drop falls from her chin as she looks reluctantly toward the court. The medium portrait includes the doorway and stored equipment behind. Daylight from outside lights her bottle and forehead, leaving the deeper shelves dark and the threshold sharply brighter than the floor inside.
